title: Little rest, many troubles
odia: ଅଳପ ନିଦକୁ ବହୁତ କଥା, ଝୁରିମରିବାକୁ କଲା ବିଧାତା
literal_meaning: Little sleep, so much happening; fate has made me pine away.
explanation: A weary complaint that troubles leave little rest. The exaggerated lament carries the feeling of being overwhelmed.
meaning_odia: ବିଶ୍ରାମ ଅଳ୍ପ, ହେଲେ ଚିନ୍ତା ଓ ଘଟଣାର ଶେଷ ନାହିଁ—ଏମିତି କ୍ଲାନ୍ତିର ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଏଠାରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
usage_example: After several demanding days, someone sighs that even bedtime brings another worry. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary cites this under happening/event. This is an editorial reading of its lament, not sleep advice.

witnesses.wording: ଅଳପ ନିଦକୁ ବହୁତ କଥା, ଝୁରିମରିବାକୁ କଲା ବିଧାତା

graphic.caption: Imagined evening: even rest brings another worry.

english_summary: Too many troubles leave too little rest: the lament voices weariness.
